scope: Only missing color, gender and age_group warnings in the specified fresh US feed; 10 parent color candidates. No external calls or mutations. This artifact is not execution authority.

diagnosis.color: Existing priority is variant gColor, exact Color selectedOption, parent gColor, then a sole taxonomy color. All 40 missing-color parents lack a usable explicit structured color field; 32 have multi-valued color-pattern taxonomy and 8 have no taxonomy color. The code intentionally does not mine narrative print names. A multi-valued taxonomy may include patterns or contradictory colors, so joining all labels would be unsafe.
diagnosis.gender: Current variant role parsing resolves Mother/Father/Girl/Boy but generic Child/Adult stays blank when taxonomy has multiple gender values. Explicit boys/son audience text exists for 140 warned child variants across 20 parents; this is a separate source-grounded opportunity, not one of the 10 proposed parent changes. Three parents with 21 warned child variants only say kids/children or Daddy and Me, leaving child gender unknown. Red Cable Knit has 31 warnings, Unisex plus Female taxonomy, and two styles; whole-family prose does not unambiguously resolve each style, so no assignment is proposed.
diagnosis.age: 98 warned sizes cross the existing generator age-group boundaries and should remain unassigned without a justified policy decision; 60 use T suffix and 4 use Y suffix, neither parsed by the current function. No new age value is proposed from abbreviation or garment appearance.

age.interpretation: Age boundary groups reflect the inspected generator, not a newly researched Google policy determination. T/Y syntax needs separate reviewed normalization with explicit year/month source support and preservation of boundary holds.

nextImplementationProposal.name: Complete only source-backed Google color metafields for the 10 reviewed parents
nextImplementationProposal.whyThisScope: The current generator already reads these exact source fields. Explicit source metafields avoid a general narrative-extraction heuristic. Parent values cover uniform palettes, and separate Ivory Stripe variant values preserve its dress/shirt versus shorts distinction.
preconditions: Root independent semantic review must approve the exact colors, including the Cobalt primary-color-only limitation.
Fresh source read must confirm exact product identities, ACTIVE state, description/title/options bindings, target metafields still absent, and no new conflicting color options; stop on drift.
Validate the current Shopify metafield definition and permitted type through the parent authorized schema workflow before any write; this proposal intentionally does not invent a mutation type.
Root owns exact reviewed mutation variables, before-state rollback evidence and external authorization.
This proposal was evaluated against US English only. Other markets require fresh generation and comparison before any coverage claim.
verificationRequired: Read back all 48 exact source fields and compare intended values.
Regenerate US candidate from fresh source; assert 291 exact prior warning IDs receive the proposed color and missing_color becomes 680 if all other source facts are unchanged.
Check 4,741 emitted rows and unchanged availability/exclusions/prices/identifiers/gender/age/size and unaffected rows; attribute updates must not enable unavailable or held products.
Preview affected other-market feeds independently; record fetched/approved status separately from candidate configuration.
nextImplementationProposal.lifecycleLimit: Source attributes remain available to the existing lifecycle collector; no manual static feed is proposed. New sizes in uniform-color parents can reuse a still-valid parent color. New types/palettes and new Ivory Stripe variants need explicit fresh color metadata; do not claim this one batch eliminates future attribute warnings.

exclusions: No GTIN, brand, fabric, shipping, price, inventory, status, publication, title, description, translation, taxonomy or feed/config/code changes.
No mapping from appearance or non-color print labels.
No change to the completed ES, FR, DE, Navy or French Hip packets.
No Merchant Center approval, visibility, traffic or profit result is claimed.

validation.separateReadbackValidation: PASS: exact evidence substrings and source hashes, 291 distinct emitted in-stock blank-color IDs, 48 unique null color targets, and warning partitions checked.

summary: 10 parent candidates support a reviewed color-source completion affecting 291 current US variants through 9 parent and 39 variant metafields. Current missing counts are color 971, gender 192, age 162. 139 color warnings are held for source disagreements, 50 lack an exact usable primary color, and 491 are outside the first bounded proposal. Gender and age require separate exact review; no new values are guessed. This is a local proposal only.
